testimonials.name: Catherine Sun
text: Ben helped me get my dream job. My whole work experience had been in big tech, and I could tell that there is a different style of interviewing, communicating, and culture in quant. They were very hands on with prepping me for the interviews, I always felt prepared and confident because of their support.
They were so on top of things that I found out I was getting an offer the night of my onsite interview.

Most importantly, I believe they are honest and transparent people. For example, I had a health issue come up when my onsite interview had already been booked. They swiftly communicated with the company and rescheduled my onsite. It was the right decision as I got an offer while still prioritizing my health.
Thank you for my life changing opportunity!

testimonials.name: Max D
text: Ben is in a league of his own as a recruiter. An industry veteran with deep connections, he knew exactly which firms were the right fit for me, guided me throughout the entire interview process, and helped me negotiate an offer at Citadel. If you’re exploring roles in quant finance or tech, Ben is the person to talk to.

testimonials.name: Roy Xiong
text: 10/10 experience with Tyler! Never had a recruiter work with me the way he did. Helped me find the firms that made the most sense for where I wanted to take my career, helped me prepare for the interview process, and made sure I got the compensation package that I needed. Would recommend everyone to work with Tyler.

testimonials.name: Alex Mott
text: I had a great experience working with Tyler. He introduced me to a variety of firms including some I never would have found on my own. I just started my new job at a startup that Tyler introduced me to, and it is exactly what I was looking for. He was on top of the process from start to finish, from introductions and prep to discussing offer negotiations and keeping on top of the contract. I highly recommend working with him.

testimonials.name: Junyoung Kim
text: Working with Kunal was a genuine pleasure. He takes the time to understand what you truly want, and his tenacity is unmatched. He kept digging until he uncovered an opportunity that was perfect for me. Thoughtful, relentless, and exceptional at his craft.

testimonials.name: Colman Seery
text: Lira’s great! She helped narrow my search to trading firms I’d actually be interested in and would not have known about otherwise, had a ton of valuable connections, and provided specific insight at every step of the process. She was responsive, but didn’t call at 7 or 8am like many recruiters in the space. Highly recommend working with her.

testimonials.name: Ryan Tan
text: Chris's mission is putting the most capable people in the highest leverage positions. It's all too familiar for him, because he himself is the most capable person in the recruiting space I've ever met. But what made Chris great to work with wasn't just his access to some of the most successful and prestigious firms, or his connections and knowledge that made the processes extremely smooth. It was his humility and unending support through every step of the way, a rare experience for me when it comes to recruiters.

testimonials.name: Scott Taver
text: Arsen was foundational in helping me land my next successful role in engineering. After getting connected he took into account my experience, expertise and desires and routed me effectively to a few different options that all led to screenings. Along the way I greatly appreciated the touchpoints, encouragement and collaboration that led to me choosing a fulfilling role that I would not have come across as I struggled in my own shotgun approach to job searching. It was instrumental to have this support in todays job search.

testimonials.name: Manik Sethi
text: Arsen is incredibly helpful, going to long lengths to make sure that you are well equipped and prepared for the interview process. With his help and support, I am now working as an Applied AI Engineer at Mercor!

bio: Ben Herman is the Founder of FF Dev Studio, the premier executive search firm for quantitative trading and technology talent. With over two decades of experience in recruiting, Ben has built a reputation as one of the most knowledgeable and results-driven talent partners in the industry.

Ben started his first executive search firm at 21 and never looked back. Over his career, he has personally billed $4.6M in a single year, generated over $150M in revenue from his first business, raised $96M from top-tier investors including Sequoia Capital, and angel invested in four unicorn companies. He has placed over 200 engineers and researchers at some of the most prestigious firms in quantitative finance, including Jane Street, Hudson River Trading, Two Sigma, PDT Partners, Citadel, and Headlands Technologies.

Today, Ben leads FF Dev Studio — formerly Herman Search — where he and his team focus on sourcing elite engineering, research, and AI talent for the world's top quantitative trading firms and VC-backed startups. His approach is built on deep relationships, radical honesty, and a genuine passion for connecting exceptional people with the right opportunities.
Outside of work, Ben is a proud dad of four, a devoted husband, and an avid collector of trading cards and sports memorabilia.

Lira has been with FF Dev Studio since day one, helping build and support the firm from the ground up. Over the past 11+ years, she has partnered with exceptional engineers, quantitative researchers, and technical leaders, helping them navigate some of the most important career decisions they'll make.Lira is known for her relationship-driven approach and believes the best recruiting happens when people are treated as long-term partners, not transactions. Her focus is on building genuine relationships, understanding what motivates people, and helping them find opportunities that align with their goals and ambitions.

As a member of FF’s founding recruiting team, Tyler has spent the last seven years helping build teams at some of the most respected firms in Big Tech and quantitative finance. From elite software engineers and machine learning researchers to technical leaders and quantitative talent, he has partnered with industry-leading organizations to bring exceptional people to already exceptional teams.Known for his straightforward Southern California communication style, Tyler believes the best recruiting relationships are built on honesty. He'll tell you when you're doing everything right, when you're making a mistake, and when there's a better path forward. Candidates and clients alike value him not just as a recruiter, but as a trusted advisor who provides candid feedback, market insight, and long-term perspective.While much of the recruiting industry is focused on the next transaction, Tyler focuses on building relationships that last. His goal isn't simply to fill a role; it's to become the person people call when they're evaluating a career move, building a team, or looking for a trusted perspective on the market.Whether you're hiring world-class talent or exploring your next opportunity, Tyler believes great outcomes start with great relationships.

Kunal Batra is a founding team member at FF, where he specializes in placing elite quantitative engineers and researchers with top-tier trading firms and select high-growth startups. He brings a rare combination of deep industry relationships and data-driven insight to every search — giving candidates a genuine edge throughout the interview process.Before FF, Kunal spent over three years at Long Ridge Partners building his expertise in quant and hedge fund talent. To date, he has completed more than 50 successful placements across the quant finance space, with a track record that speaks to both his network and his ability to match exceptional people with the right opportunities.Kunal holds a B.S. in Business and Communications from Penn State. Outside of work, he's an avid sports fan, concert-goer, and active trader across equities, futures, and crypto.

Chris is a Senior Recruiter with over 12 years of experience in recruiting. He started at an agency in Seattle focused on startups, then landed his first big tech job at Facebook. He recruited E7 engineers across both NYC and Seattle and went on to work with mid to late stage startups where he has recruited for all types of roles.That journey eventually led him to a chance introduction to industry legend Ben Herman, who pulled him into the quant trading world. Now a Senior Recruiter at FF Dev Studio, Chris focuses exclusively on top quant trading firms globally. He brings a deep, firsthand relationship with firms like EQR and a track record of successful placements there.His approach is simple: honesty and transparency above all. He gives real feedback and genuinely tries to add value, not just fill seats.Based in Portland, hiring for NYC. He likes all the regular PNW stuff like backpacking, food carts, and musical theatre.

Mike brings more than 15 years of technical recruiting experience, partnering with high-growth technology companies to identify and attract specialized engineering, research, and technical leadership talent. His work has included building technical leadership teams at Robinhood, research leadership at Cruise, and supporting Amazon’s most ambitious early-stage initiatives across AI, robotics, and autonomous systems. He has since specialized in partnering with frontier AI labs and venture-backed startups, helping founders and technical leaders build foundational teams across AI/ML Research and engineering. His work continues to focus on specialized talent for companies building at the earliest and most consequential stages of emerging technology.

Mario began his career on the buy side as a Trading Analyst at First Eagle Investment Management, where he supported market research and trade execution for the Global Value team of portfolio managers overseeing approximately $90 billion in assets. He later transitioned into specialized quantitative research and trading recruitment, focusing on systematic strategies, statistical arbitrage, high-frequency alpha, and options automated market making. He built his expertise at firms including Options Group and Carrington Fox before joining FF Dev Studio. Mario holds a double major in Economics and Psychology from Rutgers University
